high_level_description: This image showcases the packaging of a LEGO Star Wars Death Star set from the Ultimate Collector Series. The box is predominantly black with a detailed illustration of the Death Star on its surface. The Death Star is depicted in a highly intricate design, featuring various levels and sections that are characteristic of the iconic space station from the Star Wars franchise. The box includes several LEGO minifigures, which are small, detailed figures representing characters from the Star Wars universe.
